strings.不会受到攻击，恢复周围友方单位的生命: Cannot be attacked; restores the HP of nearby friendly units
strings.范围内的敌人攻击力和防御力<@ba.vup>-25%</>: Reduces the ATK and DEF of enemies within range by <@ba.vup>-25%</>
strings.范围内的敌人攻击力和防御力<@ba.vup>-30%</>: Reduces the ATK and DEF of enemies within range by <@ba.vup>-30%</>
strings.出现时会对附近的敌人造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>200%</>的法术伤害，: When appearing, deals <@ba.vup>200%</> ATK as Arts damage to nearby enemies and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> them for <@ba.vup>1</> seconds
strings.出现时会对附近的敌人造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>230%</>的法术伤害，: When appearing, deals <@ba.vup>230%</> ATK as Arts damage to nearby enemies and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> them for <@ba.vup>1.5</> seconds
strings.能够阻挡两个敌人，降低被阻挡单位的防御力: Blocks 2 enemies, and reduces the DEF of blocked units
strings.出现时<$ba.stun>晕眩</>周围敌人<@ba.vup>2</>秒: When appearing, <$ba.stun>Stuns</> surrounding enemies for <@ba.vup>2</> seconds
strings.出现时<$ba.stun>晕眩</>周围敌人<@ba.vup>2.5</>秒: When appearing, <$ba.stun>Stuns</> surrounding enemies for <@ba.vup>2.5</> seconds
strings.能够阻挡两个敌人，在<@ba.kw>集成战略</>中，出现造成的晕眩时间延长至5: Blocks 2 enemies. In <@ba.kw>Integrated Strategies</>, its Stun effect extends to 5s, and its ability of reducing the DEF of blocked enemies changes to reducing the DEF of ground enemies on the surrounding 8 tiles by <@ba.kw>400</>, and their RES by <@ba.kw>20</> (does not stack)
strings.攻击范围视为浊心斯卡蒂攻击范围的延伸: Attack Range is regarded as an extension of Skadi the Corrupting Heart's Attack Range
strings.部署时对周围四格敌人造成<@ba.vup>90%</>耀骑士临光攻击力的真实伤害: When deploying, deals <@ba.vup>90%</> ATK as True damage to enemies in the four adjacent tiles and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> them for <@ba.vup>3</> seconds. If the previously deployed Operator is from Kazimierz, deals an additional hit
strings.部署时对周围四格敌人造成<@ba.vup>100%</>耀骑士临光攻击力的真实伤: When deploying, deals <@ba.vup>100%</> ATK as True damage to enemies in the four adjacent tiles and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> them for <@ba.vup>3</> seconds. If the previously deployed Operator is from Kazimierz, deals an additional hit
strings.只能部署在召唤者攻击范围内: Can only be deployed within the summoner's Attack Range
strings.每25秒增加一只“狼影”（至多3只），每存在一只“狼影”，狼群阻挡数+1，每次攻: Gains 1 'Wolf Shadow' every 25s (up to a maximum of 3). For each 'Wolf Shadow' present, the Wolfpack gains +1 Block, and each attack inflicts an additional instance of damage; when more than 1 'Wolf Shadow' is present, upon taking lethal damage 1 'Wolf Shadow' will be lost to fully restore HP.
strings.攻击阻挡的目标时无视其175的防御力: Ignores 175 DEF when attacking a blocked target
strings.初始攻击造成<@ba.kw>法术伤害</>，只能部署在召唤者攻击范围内: The initial attack deals <@ba.kw>Arts damage</>; can only be deployed within the summoner's Attack Range
strings.可复制待部署区一名干员，若为远程时获得特性每攻击<@ba.vup>10</>次在: Copies an undeployed Operator. If it is a Ranged Operator, can split itself after every <@ba.vup>10</> attacks, automatically deploying a copy on an adjacent tile (lasts <@ba.vup>25</> seconds); if it is a Melee Operator, each attack <$ba.steal>Steals</> <@ba.vup>10</> ATK and DEF from enemies (Caps at<@ba.vup>250</>, resets after copying another Operator)
strings.技能开启时复制目标90%的生命值、攻击力、防御力、法抗，以及阻挡数、攻击间隔、攻: On skill activation, copies 90% of the target's HP, ATK, DEF, and RES, as well as Block Count, Attack Interval, Attack Range, and Initial Damage Type (Does not inherit 'does not attack' or healing type)
strings.技能开启时复制目标100%的生命值、攻击力、防御力、法抗，以及阻挡数、攻击间隔、: On skill activation, copies 100% of the target's HP, ATK, DEF, and RES, as well as Block Count, Attack Interval, Attack Range, and Initial Damage Type (Does not inherit 'does not attack' or healing type)
strings.对触碰到的首个敌人造成物理伤害，并使目标<$ba.sluggish>停顿</>\:
Deals Physical damage to the first enemy it comes in contact with and <$ba.sluggish>Slows</>
<@ba.rem>The Champagne Bomb deals additional damage after having been deployed for 3 seconds</>
strings.乌尔比安技能结束时返回该位置，并且其他干员不能部署: When skill ends, Ulpianus returns to this position and no other Operators may be deployed
strings.能够阻挡一个敌人，攻击造成<@ba.kw>真实伤害</>: Blocks 1 enemy, and attacks deal <@ba.kw>True damage</>
strings.使攻击范围内一名友方干员获得相当于凯瑟琳生命上限20%的<$ba.barrier: Grants an Operator within range a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to 20% of Catherine's Max HP (if target has not received an attack within 5s, <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> replenishes by 6% of Catherine's Max HP every second, cannot go over the starting limit); effects from Devices do not stack; Unlimited duration
strings.凛御银灰在场时添加至待部署区。部署费用随凛御银灰的技能而变化: Added to the Reserve while SilverAsh the Reignfrost is on the field. Its DP cost varies with SilverAsh the Reignfrost's skill
strings.使左侧的干员初始技力增加，再部署时间减少: Increases the initial SP of the operator to its left and reduces its Redeploy Time
strings.“变革已至”技能期间首个干员部署时，“风雪之眼”会部署至该干员所在位置，并与凛御: When the first operator is deployed during the 'Change Has Come' skill, 'Eye of the Blizzard' is deployed at that operator's position and performs a <@ba.vup>straight-line area attack</> together with SilverAsh the Reignfrost. During the skill, 'Eye of the Blizzard' can be deployed again to change its position, and its <@ba.vup>DP cost is refunded</>
strings.【炎】6名成员激活时召唤的友方单位；开战时攻击力/生命值增加【炎】干员攻击力/生: Friendly unit summoned when 6 [Yan] members are active; at the start of combat its ATK/HP increase by 30% of the total ATK/HP of the [Yan] operators (see bonds.json yanShip)
strings.自身攻击距离<@ba.vup>+2</>，攻击力<@ba.vup>+40%</>: Attack Range <@ba.vup>+2</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+40%</>; heals <@ba.vup>2</> targets and additionally heals the target or the friendly unit next to the target once for <@ba.vup>30%</> of the healing amount upon the original target; if the friendly unit to be healed is at 50% HP or lower, the healing amount is increased to <@ba.vup>150%</> of the original amount
strings.治疗目标时使其获得3点技力: Targets healed by this unit gain 3 SP
strings.攻击范围内的友方干员被击倒时获得5点技力: When allies within range are defeated, gain 5 SP
